core_idea: Haute Couture::Alteration Shop Rodion is a Damage Dealer applying sustained Inertia of Drifting, Shield pressure with consistent skill stats.
playstyle_guide:
Combat passive — **Inertia of Drifting**: Gain Inertia of Drifting Potency for every X cumulative Inertia of Drifting Count this unit consumes in this Encounter.
  - At Attack End of another ally that has Second is Welcome — snipping, activate "Patterning" against the said ally's target.
  - [Before Use] If the said target has X+ Mark of Shearing, activate as "Cutout" instead.

Combat passive — **Snipping in the Alteration Shop are Blossom Scissors**: Turn End: Gain Shield next turn equal to Inertia of Drifting Count.
  - Gain Final Power based on Inertia of Drifting Potency.
team_suggestions: Flexible pick; slotting alongside identities whose support passives provide relevant statuses or SP recovery maximises uptime.
- Pair with identities whose support passives inflict statuses this kit stacks or scales off.
